$comment: The enchanting table is vanilla's block, 12 high, its book hovering over it. At the station the block is swapped for body (vanilla's own table model, so a pack's table is the one shown) and the table's book is drawn by the scene: EnchantingTableBehavior's painter on book draws vanilla's book model, starting where the table's book hovers and gliding to the reading place (the node's place, vanilla's size, lying back, its pages square to the camera: extra.faces is the camera's position), and back on leaving. The three offers are written on its pages; a click on one enchants. On the table top, as in vanilla's screen from left to right as the camera sees it: item and lapis. The scene turns to the player at their own angle round the table (PLAYER_FREE; the body is turned back square to the world), so the camera comes from where the player stands: over the near side, looking down at the book, inside the air ring of a bookshelf setup (the shelves' faces at z -16). The hotbar stays where the HUD has it and takes clicks; over it rows of what can be enchanted and the lapis.
